speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The loaf is a finger and a half short, and it is still a penny. I am measuring it because Easter is over.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have not put a thumb on it, mistress.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A finger and a half, and not a thumb. I will not hear it called worse than it is.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nor will I. The pan is not in this house. Carry the pot, Alse, and tell me the plot while your hands are busy. What are these twins.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two brothers, Mistress. The town spends the afternoon mistaking one for the other. I play the father, Egeon, who comes looking for them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A father who has lost two sons should not be played only for a laugh. Do they come home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They come into the same street. The laugh is the street, not the loss.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And the lady, sir? Is she tall?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Arthur asked for a tall angry lady this morning. I did not write him one before dinner. Edith let his hem down at Easter, and the wind has the rest.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the hem is Edith's, and the plot is yours, and I am ruling on the plot. If a goldsmith hands a chain over for nothing, he may whistle for it. A gift on credit is not a gift.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The chain is the play's. I will not put a new debt into it to please a table. The board is threepence, and here it is.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence is the board. I am not starting the firing. It shut at Lady Day, and Michaelmas can open it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The pot is down. The loaf is by the trencher, not by the notch.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A finger and a half is what it was before you rode, and what it is now. Easter did not bake it larger.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Easter left it alone. Today she measured. That is the difference, and it is still a penny.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. You may eat. You may not tell me an end that is only everyone being someone else.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The end is that the father finds them. I will not spoil the street for you.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I am satisfied. Two sons, one father, a chain that is not a gift, and threepence on the board.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the other brother the same face, sir?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The same face, and a different door. That is the whole of it, and it is not a trick on the loaf.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will not ask which door. I came in at this one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Stay in at this one. I have never been inside a playhouse, and I am not beginning today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not inviting you. Tomorrow the Shrew is on their bill. I am at the desk. I am not in it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the desk can have you. Eat before the pot cools.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Crust or the soft end, sir?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Crust. And thank you for not calling it a thumb.
